wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Plunges 5% as Investors Retreat From AI Trade After Election
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech-heavy index enters correction territory; Dow drops more than 1,500 points

wsjHeadlines.title: Goldman’s Exclusive Club of Partners Welcomes an Influx from Wealth Management
wsjHeadlines.description: In a shift from previous years, the bank didn’t provide a gender or racial breakdown of the class.

wsjHeadlines.title: Insurer Sues Autism-Therapy Provider Over $160 Million in Allegedly Misleading Claims
wsjHeadlines.description: Elevance Health claims the Perfect Child used LLCs to charge out-of-network rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Will AI Throttle the Retirement Money Machine?
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Big Tech’s election silver lining.

wsjHeadlines.title: How the Data Center Backlash Could Play Into the Hands of Big Tech
wsjHeadlines.description: Giants like Amazon and Microsoft stand to benefit from a shakeout.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Surge, Oil Plummets on Democrat Victory
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, CVS decides to break itself up.

wsjHeadlines.title: Index Funds Are Better When They’re Lucky and Smart
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, markets digest the blue tsunami

wsjHeadlines.title: How Beer Companies Stole Happy Hour From Liquor Brands
wsjHeadlines.description: Diageo and Pernod Ricard have missed the cocktails-in-a-can craze, and investors are paying the price.

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple Is an AI Safe Haven—but Safety Isn’t Cheap
wsjHeadlines.description: Apple is the rare big tech play that hasn’t become a giant bet on the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Netflix Needs You to Watch, Not Just Pay
wsjHeadlines.description: The streamer’s ad ambitions depend on viewing hours, which have stalled.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Are Betting a Blue Wave Will Help Hospitals. Don’t Count on It.
wsjHeadlines.description: Markets are anticipating a reversal of Trump’s Medicaid cuts. That may be easier said than done.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Market Isn’t Buying Skydance’s Balance-Sheet Math
wsjHeadlines.description: The media conglomerate’s goodwill alone exceeds its stock-market value.

wsjHeadlines.title: BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank  is expected to join its peers in raising borrowing costs Thursday, with the Fed, ECB and BoJ having each raised rates at least once since start of U.S.-Iran war.

wsjHeadlines.title: NatWest Shares Fall After Bank’s Interest Income Guidance Disappoints
wsjHeadlines.description: The British high-street bank’s shares dropped after it forecast weaker-than-expected interest income next year.

wsjHeadlines.title: ING Launches Buyback But Flags Job Cuts and Unit Restructuring
wsjHeadlines.description: The Dutch bank launched a new buyback program of $1.84 billion and set out plans to restructure its wholesale banking unit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Posts Profit, Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender reported third-quarter net profit that beat market expectations despite a volatile macroeconomic backdrop in its home country.

wsjHeadlines.title: UBS CEO Signals Possible Switzerland Exit Over Capital Demands
wsjHeadlines.description: The group is caught in a dispute with lawmakers in its home country over proposals to introduce more demanding capital requirements on its foreign subsidiaries.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Rheinmetall, Renk, Air France-KLM and more in the latest Market Talks covering Auto and Transport.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Defense Stocks Under Pressure After Mixed Earnings, Midterm Results
wsjHeadlines.description: European defense companies were in decline after a mixed set of earnings and midterm election results that cast doubt on the extent of U.S. military spending going forward.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Rally on Divided Government as AI Wobbles Continue
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks surged as oil prices tumbled and traders bet a divided government would be good for business, offsetting ongoing unease about artificial-intelligence bets.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Blue Wave Sets Off a Potential Regime Change in Markets
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stock indexes surged on hope that legislative gridlock, an AI slowdown and checks on presidential power will mark the start of a new era for the economy.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Jump After Democrats Sweep Congress
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks are surging as investors react to a blue wave that puts Democrats in control of both chambers of Congress.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Virgin Islands in Crisis
wsjHeadlines.description: Restarting an idled oil refinery isn’t a cure-all for the territory’s financial woes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Elon Musk Will Turn Kids Into Capitalists
wsjHeadlines.description: Bank Hapoalim gave shares to customers, many of whom had never invested before.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Ethics Rules Behind Weil Gotshal’s ‘Partner Run’
wsjHeadlines.description: Bans on outside ownership and noncompete agreements make it hard for law firms to innovate—and sometimes even to survive.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Sports Bet by Any Other Name Is Still a Bet
wsjHeadlines.description: The CFTC has neither the competency nor statutory authority to regulate gambling.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | An AI Halloween Market Scare
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto isn’t risk-free after all, as thieves take Binance for $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s IPO Will Be a National-Security Win for Taiwan
wsjHeadlines.description: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America’s top foreign policy interests.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Extend Post-Midterm Gains
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures added to the previous day’s gains with U.S. yields falling and the dollar steady after post-midterm losses.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Inventories Rise By 77 Billion Cubic Feet
wsjHeadlines.description: Natural gas futures remained lower after data showed U.S. inventories increased by more than usual last week.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Recover Some Lost Ground
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures were picking up some of the previous session’s heavy post-U.S. midterm losses, but with the market still showing optimism about prospects for Middle East diplomacy.

wsjHeadlines.title: ArcelorMittal Says Europe’s Steel Tariffs Are Boosting Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Europe’s largest steelmaker booked a 34% surge in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization over the third quarter of the year.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold futures, Canfor, Canadian  miners and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Sterling Turns Higher Vs Euro After BOE Lifts Rates
wsjHeadlines.description: Sterling turned higher against the euro, but was flat against the dollar after the BOE voted 8-1 to raise interest rates by 25 basis points to 4.0% Thursday.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.30% to 96.94
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index fell 0.3%, down five of the past six trading days.
